task: Unrestricted 4x4 PPT state with Schmidt number >= 3 (N4), or proof that none exists.
state: PARKED; target OPEN; N4 UNKNOWN. All 2026-10-29 work is WRITTEN or WRITTEN-checked-in-kernel and unreviewed. Novelty is unclear.
delivered_this_cycle: Exact filter-lift bridge (Theorems 1-3, Corollary 4). A 2-positive map M_4->M_n with a Schmidt-rank<=4 negative vector on any PPT state on C^4 (x) C^m yields an explicit 4x4 PPT state and an explicit 2-block-positive separator with negative pairing. The converse holds, so N4 is equivalent to this condition. At least (n-4)(m-4)+1 negative eigenvalues force N4. If N4 fails, every detecting 4x5/M_5 pair has exactly one negative eigenvalue, an invertible eigenvector, and the inequality lambda(1-s^2)<=Lambda s^2.

Exact independent replay of the explicit Krebs-Gachechiladze 4x5 PPT source (arXiv:2509.07086v1, read as a fresh public source and disclosed): birank (9,10) and a new exact 5-term degree-4 identity putting psi00^4 in the ideal of 3x3 minors, so SN>=3. Range-inheritance lemma recorded.
exact_remaining_gap: N4 needs an exactly certified 2-positive map M_4->M_n (n>=4) that detects an explicit 4 x m PPT state of Schmidt number >=3 with at least (n-4)(m-4)+1 negative eigenvalues, or more generally a Schmidt-rank<=4 negative vector. The other route is an exact PPT operator with ranges inside such a source's range, psi00 content, and Bob support of dimension <=4. The detection margin of the KG source is ~3e-7, so gridding or interval certification of its separator is infeasible. The floating-point evidence (one negative link eigenvalue with an invertible eigenvector; rank-4 filter minimum positive; generic filters' SN2 distances below Frank-Wolfe gap; range-criterion grid hits PPT-incompatible) matches the rigidity predicted if N4 fails, but it is exploratory only and carries no global weight.
